scope: Form inventory, pinned schema reads, pure validation and reviewed draft schema changes
Live Action definitions, all nine shipped templates, duplication, order, bar settings and manifest
Separate real invocation, inbox read/write/export and mail authority
Scoped record identities, exact version changes, bulk and purge selections
Bounded cross-source pagination, CSV exports and verified attachment streams
Atomic source-database records, request receipts and delivery intents
Stable Studio request identities, displayed versions and lost-response retries
Owner-session rollback of interrupted live Action changes without resuming revoked work

verification.note: Reproduced the missing-limit failure before the fix; verifies retry, actor/form/window isolation, rollback, mail denial, non-storing forms and retained replay.
Combined real catalog synthetic wire integration; includes 67 shared lifecycle checks.

verification.command: PHP lint of services, adapter, migration, business endpoints and submit.php
git diff --check on owned modified files

safety_evidence: All fixtures use disposable canonical roots and verify constructor injection before setup.
Schema reads do not imply inbox authority; real invocation does not imply inbox read; export and mail require separate grants.
Validation creates no business database, record, upload or notification.
Repeated invocation preserves exact record IDs; attempted or uncertain delivery is never automatically sent again.

Authenticated form limits use the published configured maximum (default ten), never a caller-supplied IP. Successful receipt replay consumes no extra quota, and receipt failure rolls back the record and counter together.
Record and Action mutations require caller request IDs and captured versions; server adapters never fetch a fresh write version.
Recovery checks current owner session, retained installation, exact path state, expiry and digest, and preserves conflicting bytes.
Original and recovering actor attribution remain separate. A repaired request is terminal and cannot resume.
No production or persistent database migration, actual SMTP delivery, or provider request was performed.
limits: Real invocation with file-upload fields is explicitly unsupported; existing authenticated attachment download remains supported.
Record deletion and purge retain attachment files for separately authorized maintenance.
Delivery tests use injected transport fixtures; no claim of exactly-once external delivery.
Business browser behavior is state-tested; no visual browser qualification is claimed here.
Owner recovery UI integration is owned by the unified recovery surface and is not claimed complete by this service evidence.
Action configuration journals are bounded to 512 rows and 16 MiB; exhaustion fails explicitly.
Synthetic MCP wire tests do not constitute additional named-client qualification.
